title: Not accurate at all
body: 3 local locations show 2 highly and one low in stock. How about zero because I checked against the Costco App. And shop there weekly. It hasn’t even exist for the last 5 months. Use the Costco App is way better.

title: Was Useful until..
body: the developers got greedy hiding features behind paywall. Deleting.

title: $7 wasted
body: I was looking for a specific item so bought a month subscription. Turns out all the deals were across the country. The search function is very limited, I’m not actually able to easily search for thing (categories are huge - I don’t need to see candles when all I’m looking for is furniture for my new apartment). If there was a week free trial or the price point was much cheaper this app would make more sense. If I find some value in the remaining month I’ll change this review.

title: Not accurate at all
body: Used for multiple locations, app needs work as accuracy is off. I noticed items shown discounted and in stock but the items have been out for at least a couple months.

title: Great app, randomly stopped working!
body: I really love this app but one day I opened it and it was empty - like I could flick through the screens but it showed zero items in each category I have tried deleted and redownloading the app many times, nothing fixes it. And there doesn’t appear to be a way to report bugs. Very frustrating!

title: You can’t really buy anything
body: The app isn’t useful because the Costco inventory reports on which it’s based are inaccurate when they get to the very last few items. They’ll be sold out yet the app shows low stock. So you can’t really buy things.

title: Don’t waste your money on premium
body: Data was over a week old- waste of money

title: Downloaded App to Search for Costco Item
body: I made multiple searches for sunglasses and not one pair of sunglasses appeared. I do not recommend this app.

title: Can't change zip code for local warehouses
body: I disabled the location detection on all of my devices, so I usually get the home page for stores in Miami when I go to retail websites. HOWEVER, this app won't allow me to change the zip code and I'm not going to turn on my location detection bc of one app.

title: Inacurrate
body: Showing in stock items but the store didnt have any

title: Inventory data is not accurate
body: Downloaded this app and sent me on a wild goose chase looking for an item which was out of stock at all stores. Deleted my subscription and will request a refund. If the data isn’t accurate, it isn’t valuable. Wanted this to work, but it’s a dud.

title: $80/year??? No way
body: What a joke. I was trying to find one item, and their website intentionally withheld the stores that had it in stock saying I need to download the app. So I did. Then it wanted to charge me $80/year to search beyond my 3 closest stores. No thanks. I’d have paid $5 for lifetime access. Beyond that you can eat a bag of mallard ducks.

title: Incorrect Inventory
body: I am using the free version to try this out. Inventory was incorrect in two Costco that I visited. App shows as green (in stock) but there was nothing to be found.

title: no thanks
body: downloaded the app to check one thing after being forced to from the website to look and see…. the one item i wanted to check was under the premium subscription. instant delete

title: Not accurate for my local stores “last checked 2 hours ago” for most things wrong
body: Not accurate for most of my local stores, when it says “Last checked x hours ago” can no longer be trusted most in/out of stock or even prices is not accurate most of the times on several items over several months when I’m at the store, when I verify with the store the item may not have been in stock for weeks, even tough the app says it was and was “verified 2 hours ago”. Also, I accidentally (my fault) purchased a year and am stuck with it, no refunds. Buyer beware. Don’t delay, make sure you verify its accuracy during the trial (if they have it still) o small month before committing (din’t let it auto bill the subscritpionand forget like me)

title: Inaccurate
body: We were presented with a very large list of clearance items supposedly available at the 3 warehouses we are near to. The app listed many more items than we really saw on clearance, and a number of items that the app said were on clearance at the specific warehouse but were not. Overall food items seemed reasonably accurate but clothing was completed inaccurate perhaps 10% of the listed items were available. I realize this is a Costco issue to a great extent - I've been a member for 25 years and their inventory system is pretty much 1970's at best - but if the underlying data is unreliable it defeats the purpose of the app regardless of where the data comes from.

title: Good app / bad pricing
body: The app is good but the yearly sub is more expensive than Costco membership. I think there’s a pricing mistake here. It’d have a huge user base if the price were better positioned.

title: Need one time purchase option
body: I’d pay for a one time purchase option but I’m tired of having to pay for a subscription for everything.

title: Not all items show up
body: The app doesn’t actually let you search any product you want. I wanted the price history of two different products and it doesn’t show it at all, very disappointing.

title: Very Useful!
body: Very reliable for tracking products that don’t always appear on the Costco app.

title: Best shopping app I own by far
body: NEVER rate or write reviews on apps. Felt compelled to with this one. TL;DR: If you shop Costco regularly and aren’t using this, I suspect you are losing money without realizing it. The key is learning how the app works, accepting Costco’s own inventory tracking limitations, and keeping up with the tool’s growing set of features. Within months of buying the premium version, I’d already saved many times its cost. One huge benefit is the clean, clear tracking of price changes on what you’ve already purchased. Just yesterday, saved close $20 on 30-day price drop refunds I wouldn’t have known about without the app flagging them. Having paid over the years for many apps whose long-term value proved questionable, this one truly shines.

title: Really useful
body: It’s not 100% accurate at times but most of the time it’s very useful to see if items are in stock and the pricing! The only negative is that I find the subscription too much money for what you get, I’d gladly pay the $80 for a lifetime sub and maybe around $20 for a yearly but the current pricing is too high for me to subscribe and the free version does most of what I need anyway. Wish the official Costco app had this functionality!

title: Very smart app
body: It’s very smart!

title: Impressive
body: I wish this app was the warehouse tab of our favorite club app, as it’s impressive. I plan to purchase the yearly plan to support. Two things that would be nice 1. Scanning product barcodes to pull up the item instead of the sign 2. Tracking Ecom orders for price drops (I understand this might be difficult)

title: All about Costco
body: Great App for Costco lovers!!!

title: Just, Simply GREAT !
body: The best app ever made for shopping best prices and it is pretty accurate.Well worth the premium. U won’t regret it. Saving gas, time and effort, as well as $. Still can’t grasp how it does it. It is like Magic. Well as long as it is legal, the technical stuff is where the developers should excel and are indeed. Thank you!

title: Awesome
body: This app is definitely helpful in helping you find clearance items, mind you that Costco may have some inaccuracies with reporting in stock or low stock. It’s always best to call the warehouse before going to make sure the item you’re looking for is available. Wish there was a bigger selection for stores when you pay for premium since where I live there is tons of Costcos around possible allowing up to 20 stores? Also noticed trending page on your site, perhaps adding that to the app? Also when searching all stores. Being able to filter by state would help

title: great app and new update fix bugs over time when report
body: there will be bugs at some update. Stock generally correct 60-70% for clearance by nature.

title: Now one of my most used apps
body: Crazy to have all of the price data in your pocket. The velocity of updates improving the app are really impressive. Please keep it up!

title: Very Impressive
body: Deal searching is amazing! I wrote a critical review complaining about the lack of deal filters which cluttered the app with clothing that likely had scrap sizes left. Within 3 days the developer responded to my critique and updated the app with filters that greatly improve the user experience. Super awesome!

title: See discounts/markdowns and price history anytime you want. Time and money saver!
